item.description:
• Knobs: a page names what is worth tuning, and the inspector shows controls for it, with saved versions and Copy Values
  • A colour knob opens M42's own colour picker
  • m42 open lets an agent show you a reference in M42
  • m42 current reports a page's knob values
  • A page's card picture is taken in the page's open layout, not squeezed to the card's size
